recipe.visualDefinition: A soft-focus, mid-century portrait of a woman with a 1960s bouffant hairstyle and a yellow flower tucked behind her ear, set against a dappled, sun-drenched garden background with heavy bokeh. The lighting is warm and diffused, characteristic of vintage Ektachrome or Kodachrome film stocks.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's pink lace garment against green/yellow bokeh background
Yellow flower accent echoing the warm highlights in the foliage
Soft, low-contrast shadows on the face contrasting with sharp eye detail
Centered subject with asymmetrical typographic placement in the upper right quadrant
coreInvariants: Analog film grain and slight chromatic aberration
Muted, warm color palette with a dominant magenta/pink hue
1960s hair and makeup styling (winged eyeliner, flip-out hair ends)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, woman positioned slightly left of center, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the yellow flower behind the ear.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's face to the flower, then upward to the display text, and finally down to the hands in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant blurred foliage in the upper right and left margins provides breathing room for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted magenta and pink (clothing and skin tones)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Soft sage greens and creamy yellows (background foliage)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key values with low-to-medium saturation; shadows are lifted and tinted warm.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or digital-looking primary colors

letterConstructionRules: Lowercase-style 'a' and 'u' mixed with uppercase proportions
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'C' and 'L' are stylized with soft, rounded ends
The 'A' lacks a crossbar or has a very low, curved one
The 'E' features a curved middle bar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Small, technical sans-serif for metadata at the very top edges.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal lines with arrowheads for technical metadata
Small rectangular logo frame in the bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the uniform stroke and rounded terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus 1960s style color photograph of a woman with a brown bouffant hairstyle and a yellow daisy behind her ear, wearing a pink lace top, standing in a sun-dappled garden with heavy bokeh. Analog film texture, warm vintage tint.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large display title in the upper right using a rounded, purple, geometric sans-serif font. Add small technical metadata in the top corners with thin arrow lines.

verificationChecks: Is the hair styled in a 1960s flip?
Is the background sufficiently blurred into bokeh circles?
Is the typography purple and rounded?
Does the image have a warm, analog film grain?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the purple text is legible against the bokeh
Verify the 'flip' at the ends of the hair
Confirm the presence of analog-style grain
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Portrait + Soft Focus Bokeh + 1960s Styling + Geometric Rounded Typography
